title: zMPvPRooms
description: Highly optimized PvP room system with duels, FFA (2v2, 3v3, etc..), and clan wars.
body:
# ⚔️ zMPvPRooms **Advanced PvP Room System for Modern Minecraft Servers** --- ## 📖 Overview zMPvPRooms is a high-performance and fully configurable PvP arena system that allows you to create isolated combat rooms for players. **Supported modes:** - 1v1 Duels - FFA (Free For All) - Team fights - Clan vs Clan wars Built with performance and stability in mind — zero TPS drops even on large servers. --- ## 🎮 Game Modes ### NORMAL - Auto-join using WorldGuard regions - Supports 1v1, FFA, and teams - Rewards and effects on win - Optional time limits ### CLAN - Clan vs Clan battles - Invitation-based system - Requires UltimateClans or uClans --- ## ⚙️ Key Features - **Async SQLite (WAL)** – No lag, no TPS drops - **Crash Protection** – Players are safely restored after crashes - **Anti-Exploit System** – Blocks commands, menus, and containers - **Custom Effects** – Titles, ActionBars, BossBars & Fireworks - **Visual Editor** – Easy arena creation with GUI + Wand - **Statistics System** – Kills, deaths, wins, KDR, streaks --- ## 🔧 Commands
📋 Click to view all commands ``` 📌 GENERAL /zmrooms help - Show help menu /zmrooms reload - Reload plugin configuration 🎮 ARENA MANAGEMENT /zmrooms create - Create a new arena (type: NORMAL/CLAN) /zmrooms delete - Delete an existing arena /zmrooms edit - Edit arena settings (interactive mode) /zmrooms stop - Force stop an ongoing arena 👥 PLAYER ACTIONS /zmrooms join - Join an available arena /zmrooms leave - Leave your current arena /zmrooms spectate - Spectate an arena /zmrooms spectate leave - Stop spectating 👑 CLAN & INVITES /zmrooms invite - Invite a clan to an arena /zmrooms accept - Accept an arena invitation 📊 STATISTICS /zmrooms stats - Show your personal statistics ```
--- ## 📊 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)
📋 Click to view all placeholders ``` 📌 GENERAL %zmrooms_currentzone% - Current arena or "none" 📊 STATISTICS %zmrooms_kills% - Total kills %zmrooms_deaths% - Total deaths %zmrooms_wins% - Total wins %zmrooms_losses% - Total losses %zmrooms_kdr% - Global K/D ratio %zmrooms_streak% - Current win streak 🎮 MODES %zmrooms_mynormalkills% - Normal kills %zmrooms_mynormaldeaths% - Normal deaths %zmrooms_mynormalwins% - Normal wins %zmrooms_mynormallosses% - Normal losses %zmrooms_myclankills% - Clan kills %zmrooms_myclandeaths% - Clan deaths %zmrooms_myclanwins% - Clan wins %zmrooms_myclanlosses% - Clan losses 🏆 LEADERBOARD NAMES %zmrooms_top__% Cols: normal_wins, clan_wins, normal_kills, clan_kills, normal_deaths, clan_deaths Ex: %zmrooms_top_normal_wins_1% 📈 LEADERBOARD VALUES %zmrooms_top__value_% Ex: %zmrooms_top_normal_wins_value_1% ```
--- ## 📥 Installation 1. Drop the plugin into your `/plugins` folder 2. Restart your server 3. Run `/zmrooms setspawn` 4. Create your first arena --- ## 📌 Requirements - **Java 17+** - **Minecraft 1.19 – 1.21** ### Soft Dependencies - PlaceholderAPI - WorldGuard - UltimateClans / uClans - Vault (optional) --- ## 💬 Support [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/R7PNG2fChs) --- **Take your PvP to the next level** ⚔️
